## Problem and outcome

Explain the concrete problem, what changes, and the resulting behavior.

## Scope and traceability

Reference the stable CP work-package ID and canonical GitHub issue. Use `Refs`
for partial work; only close an issue when every acceptance criterion is met.

## Research, contracts, rights and consumers

Identify exact upstream versions, schema changes, source-use decisions,
unknowns and affected receiving consumers. State when these do not apply.

## Verification

Record commands actually run, their results, and meaningful rejection tests.
Distinguish local conformance from source truth, rights clearance and deployment.

## Review and remaining acceptance

Record the independent review required by organization policy, remaining work,
rollback/migration impact and consumer receipts. Do not invent approval.
